issues.detail: Error scenarios and edge case handling are incomplete; network failures, malformed API responses, server initialization failures, and comprehensive logging strategies are not addressed.
Client configuration examples are Claude-specific (Code and Desktop); limited guidance for Cursor, generic MCP clients, or HTTP-based agents despite mentioning compatibility.

scenarios.name: postgres-query-mcp
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies all four rubric requirements: uses Zod for inputSchema (import and z.object), implements thorough multi-statement rejection with semicolon/quote parsing, provides BOTH a read-only database role SQL script AND statement_timeout configuration, and includes explicit Inspector testing instructions (Step 6). Response B fails critical requirements: uses plain JSON schema instead of Zod, lacks statement_timeout configuration (only has idleTimeoutMillis), provides no read-only role setup, and omits Inspector verification entirely; its multi-statement validation only checks the first keyword, allowing 'SELECT ... ; DELETE ...' to slip through.

scenarios.name: slack-api-mcp
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers all rubric requirements: Zod schemas with type safety, AbortSignal.timeout(15_000) explicitly implemented, environment variable loading with validation, and detailed testing instructions using the Inspector tool with concrete examples. Response B omits two critical rubric requirements: no timeout parameters are set on API calls (uses WebClient directly without timeout configuration), and provides no testing instructions (no mention of Inspector, mcp dev, or how to verify functionality).

scenarios.name: docs-resource-mcp
scenarios.rationale: Response B correctly uses ResourceTemplate with URI path parameters and returns contents array with uri/mimeType/text fields as specified in the rubric; Response A uses manual request handlers without ResourceTemplate and returns an incorrect response format (type instead of mimeType, missing uri), failing two core rubric requirements.
